AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item.Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City’s website under Parklands Committee Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
The Parklands Committee, at the direction of the Committee Chair with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Parklands Committee meetings.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
PUBLIC WORK DIRECTOR'S REPORT
COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Parklands Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.
CITIZEN APPLICATIONS
1.
PC-583-24; APPLICATION TO REMOVE ONE PINE TREE LOCATED IN THE PARKLANDS ADJACENT AND AT THE REAR OF 1624 VIA ZURITA
Applicant: Eric Arosemena, 1701 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following available actions: (1) Approve the request to remove one Pine tree located adjacent and at the rear of 1624 Via Zurita and approve the Conditions of Approval; (2) Deny the request; or (3) Provide alternative direction.
Staff Report
2.
PC-584-24; APPLICATION TO TOP ONE HEDGE OF TREES LOCATED ADJACENT TO 1501 VIA LOPEZ
Applicant: Scott Martin, 1061 Victoria Ave, Venice, CA 90291
On behalf of Lin and Eddie Chen
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following actions: (1) Approve the request to top one hedge of trees adjacent to 1501 Via Lopez, and approve the Conditions of Approval, (2) Deny the request; or (3) Provide alternative direction.
Staff Report
3.
PC585-24; APPLICATION TO REMOVE THREE QUEEN PALMS LOCATED IN THE PARKWAY ADJACENT TO 2116 PASEO DEL MAR
Applicant: James Musick, 1209 W. 228th Street, Torrance, CA 90502 On behalf of Tom and Judy Colich
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following available actions: (1) Approve the removal of three Queen palms located adjacent to 2116 Paseo Del Mar and approve the conditions of approval; (2) Deny the request; or (3) Provide alternative directions.
Staff Report
4.
PC-586-24; APPLICATION TO REMOVE TWO CAROB TREES LOCATED IN THE PARKWAY ADJACENT TO 2213 VIA ACALONES AND PLANT AND MAINTAIN ANNUALLY THE DESIGNATED STREET TREE AT 13 FEET
Applicant: Richard Sullivan, 2220 Via Acalones, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following actions: (1) Approve the removal of two trees locate adjacent 2213 Via Acalones and approve the Conditions of Approval ; (2) Deny the application; or (3) Provide alternative directions.
Staff Report
Amended Staff Report
5.
PC-587-24; APPLICATION TO REMOVE THREE CAROB TREES LOCATED IN THE PARKWAYS ADJACENT TO 2221 AND 2224 VIA ACALONES
Applicant: Tom Bechler, 2229 Via La Brea, Palos Verdes Estates, CA,90274
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following available actions: (1) Approve the removal of three Carob trees located in the parkways adjacent to 2221 and 2224 Via Acalones and approve the Conditions of Approval; (2) Deny the request; or (3) Provide alternative directions.
Staff Report
Amended Staff Report
6.
PC-588-24; APPLICATION TO REMOVE TWO CAROB TREES LOCATED IN THE PARKWAYS ADJACENT TO 2225 AND 2228 VIA ACALONES
Applicant: David and Mary Kelliny, 2233 Via La Brea, Palos Verdes Estates, CA, 90274
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following available actions: (1) Approve the removal of two Carob trees located in the parkways adjacent to 2225 and 2228 Via Acalones and approve the Conditions of Approval; (2) Deny the request; or (3) Provide alternative directions.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
None.
COMMITTEE CHAIR AND COMMITTEE MEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Committee Chair and Committee Members to provide comments, reports on community activities, subcommittees, and proposed topics to be calendared on a future Committee agenda.
ADJOURNMENT TO THURSDAY, January 9, 2025, AT 6:30 P.M.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, and on the City's Website (pvestates.org) not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 14th day of November 2024. Tameka Cook, City Clerk
